title: Spiced Bread for Menara Senja
summary: Marsiyah lent you an old padded satchel before your first assignment. Deliver warm spiced bread to Jumel at Menara Senja and hear the story in his grandfather's journal.
hint: Follow the winding stone path north. Sprint on safe ground, jump, and open your Glider Cape on the way down. Press E to climb lantern-marked ledges.

title: An Entrusted Song for Telaga Sumi
sender: Tiwano (Bahtari House of Sails), via Pos Nilasar
summary: Carry Tiwano's family song to his wife, Bu Lamit, at Telaga Sumi without altering it or concealing its condition. Its imperfect notes preserve a human presence.
hint: Follow the lanterns west and walk across the footbridge. Press Q for Ruru's help; press E to inspect or install ladders.

title: Supplies for the Sister Post
summary: Record two bundles of supplies and a travel permit, then check access to the sister post. Report the cargo's condition honestly.
hint: Read the Council gate notice and meet Kesa.

title: The Rekindling Letter's Mandate
sender: Marsiyah, fourth-generation keeper of the letter
summary: Check both warning signs and press the back of the stamped letter against the plate. Keep the letter sealed.
hint: Confirm Marsiyah's instructions and meet Kesa before crossing the storm to 009.
